name: @colab/als-differ
description: Semantic diff engine for Ableton Live Set (.als) files. Strips non-musical noise, diffs by structural identity, produces human-readable change reports.

ip.priorArt: none — first semantic .als differ in existence
coreAlgorithms: SAX-based XML parse with junk field stripping during stream
60+ junk element classifications from .als XML schema analysis
Hierarchical diff: tracks → devices → clips → notes
MIDI note diff by NoteId with velocity/duration/probability tracking
Semantic commit message generation from diff summaries
